result_text:
All four period payment lists now leave out payments on cancelled invoices. The full test suite passes. I didn't add a test for the cancelled-invoice case.

The change is in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStorePart04.java`. I added `AND i.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the SQL of these four methods, the same filter the customer statement query already uses:
- `findPaymentsByPeriod`
- `findPaymentsByPeriodAndCustomer`
- `findPaymentsByRegionAndPeriod`
- `findPaymentsBySalesRepAndPeriod`

The statement query (`findPaymentsByCustomerAndPeriodExcludingCancelled`) already excluded cancelled invoices, so I left it alone. I didn't commit.
